metadata.description: Red tiles form a handled ceramic pitcher with a floral ornament inspired by Kosiv. Blue ground slows the craft; red ground is lethal until captured. Floating terraces surround the motif, with stepping stones along the lower route. 5 yellow bouncers, two outer patrols and 9 island-contour patrols guard the field. No horizontal barrier bars. Start at bottom center and reveal 75%.
